chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The site of the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام is a channel from the channels of Paradise."

key_terms.تُرْعَةٌ: a channel or branch of flowing water

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the exalted spiritual rank of the resting place of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام. It presents his grave as a place connected to Paradise, indicating its sanctity and distinction in Shia tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3166 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The site of the grave of Husayn (as) is a channel from the channels of Paradise."
